docs/agents/rules/*.route: Direct, and ONLY for a file with no row of its own: a hand edit to a generated fragment is overwritten silently by `npm run gen:rule-fragments` (mantahostels#2586). However it is authored, a fragment reaches a session by one of two routes, or `scripts/check-guard-registry.js` FAILs. Printed: it lands alongside the accessor call in a wired emitter (a guard, a hook, a workflow, or a lib one of them reaches), or UNPRINTED-RULE. Session-fetched: `docs/agents/rules/manifest.json` lists it and a wired command index names it, or UNINDEXED-RULE (mantahostels#2496). A `rule:<id>` trigger naming no fragment FAILs on ORPHAN-TRIGGER, and a manifest id naming none on MANIFEST-ORPHAN. **Nothing asserts that a fragment keeps a trigger line** (mantahostels#2006), so never keep one believing a gate requires it

docs/roadmap-digest.md.route: `gen-roadmap-digest.js`, committed with the HTML. `check-digest-version.js` fails on a drifted version line, `check-digest-render.js` on bytes differing from a fresh render — of the HTML, the digest and the generator as the index holds them, never the worktree. A generator that will not run refuses too, and so does a staged deletion of any of the three (mantahostels#2894); only a path that was never in the index makes the gate skip. `roadmap-digest.yml` runs it on the sweeps as well (mantahostels#2895)

docs/test-read-edges.json.route: `npm run gen:test-read-edges`, re-derived from the tracked test corpus; never hand-edited. `--check` gates it in .husky/pre-commit.

What a --plugin-dir load of this repo registers; a release renders its own copy.
hooks/hooks.json.route: `node scripts/generate-plugin-hooks.js`, re-derived from self-plugin/hooks/hooks.json; never hand-edited. `--check` gates it in .husky/pre-commit.

hooks/register.ts.route: Edited directly. A new mod is one import and one call here, plus the tests that list each mod; npm run typecheck's fifth pass checks it.

hooks/tsconfig.json.role: Type-checks hooks/register.ts, with the liveness mod's copy of the engine's declarations and the liveness and delivery mods' state contracts.
hooks/tsconfig.json.route: Edited directly; npm run typecheck runs it as its fifth pass.

self-plugin/.claude-plugin/marketplace.j.role: The wfc-self local marketplace: one plugin entry whose source is its own directory, so self-plugin/ loads in place as a plugin carrying only hooks/hooks.json. No plugin.json; this entry is the manifest.
self-plugin/.claude-plugin/marketplace.j.route: Edited directly. Each machine registers it once, by the setup step in docs/environment.md §13; never shipped to adopters.

self-plugin/hooks/hooks.json.role: The core's own hook registration: every hook workflow-core runs on itself, loaded in place as the wfc-self plugin at session start. .claude/settings.json keeps only the canary that refuses a session this did not load.
self-plugin/hooks/hooks.json.route: Edited directly, an ordinary repo edit with no permission prompt; then re-render hooks/hooks.json with `node scripts/generate-plugin-hooks.js`, which also writes each PreToolUse hook's `onFailure`, `block` on exactly the deny-capable ones (#2670). check-registrations.js refuses a command registered here and in .claude/settings.json.
